findings.title: Virtual Controls Not Initialized at Startup
findings.description: Virtual controls use lazy initialization (only when touch detected). In WASM, controls don't appear until user touches, causing confusion. InitializeVirtualControls() exists but is only called reactively.
findings.impact: Users see no on-screen controls to interact with. Game appears broken on mobile browsers.

findings.title: Virtual Controls Not Rendered
findings.description: Virtual controls have Draw() method but it's never called in render pipeline. Controls update but remain invisible.
findings.impact: Even when initialized, controls are invisible. Users cannot see D-pad or buttons.

findings.title: Touch Detection Working Correctly
findings.description: Touch input auto-detection using ebiten.TouchIDs() works as designed. Correctly switches to touch mode when touch detected.

findings.title: Platform Detection Correct
findings.description: IsTouchCapable() correctly identifies WASM (js/wasm) as touch-capable platform.

fixes.title: Initialize Virtual Controls Eagerly for WASM
fixes.description: Add explicit call to InitializeVirtualControls() for touch-capable platforms at game startup.

fixes.title: Add Virtual Control Rendering Methods
fixes.description: Add HasVirtualControls() and DrawVirtualControls() helper methods to InputSystem for clean integration with render loop.

fixes.title: Call Virtual Control Draw in Game Loop
fixes.description: Add call to DrawVirtualControls() in game draw loop to render controls on top of game content.

successCriteria: venture.wasm file is non-zero size (>1MB expected)

riskAssessment.reasoning: All changes are additive (no modifications to existing logic). Virtual control code already exists and works on native mobile. We're only fixing initialization timing and adding render calls. Desktop builds unaffected due to platform detection guards.
mitigations: Existing mobile code already tested and working
No modifications to core game logic
Easy to revert if issues found
